conclusion: Sustained reading remains empirically unvalidated; rendering/reflow checks are not reading outcomes.

findings.priority: P1 conditional on a sustained-reading release claim
findings.finding: No human evidence establishes sustained-reading suitability; current fixture explicitly disclaims it. README promises UI, headings, short labels and numerical data, not validated sustained reading.
findings.acceptance_test: Keep sustained-reading status unvalidated until a preregistered human comparison is completed; publish observations and limits, not universal superiority.

findings.finding: A is always Tabuna and B always system-ui; identical short bilingual content appears side by side. This is useful visual inspection but cannot produce an unbiased reading-time or comprehension comparison.
findings.acceptance_test: Use sequential anonymous conditions, counterbalanced order and matched distinct passages; conceal assignment from scorer and wait for fonts before timed exposure.

findings.finding: The 1x/2x fixture factor doubles CSS font size; it does not establish performance on actual 1x/2x displays, older readers, corrected vision or low vision.
findings.acceptance_test: Record physical display density, OS scaling, browser zoom and devicePixelRatio separately; include age/vision variation in a pilot, with descriptive subgroup outcomes only.

findings.finding: Fixture font_sha256 labels the TTF hash even though the browser loads WOFF2. The served WOFF2 matches dist WOFF2, but provenance should identify both explicitly.
findings.acceptance_test: Store source_ttf_sha256 and served_woff2_sha256 separately with OS/browser/resolved system font and trial configuration.

pilot.proposed_gates_are: Product decisions to preregister, not established norms or statistical non-inferiority

limitations: No universal readability or accessibility claims
Pilot sample size not a power calculation
